comparison_semantics: ordinary-GP prediction disagreement relative to SpaceX-E/SupGP higher-quality historical reference; not ground-truth error
selection_policy: CREATION_DATE <= evaluation_time; latest CREATION_DATE, then EPOCH, then GP_ID

builder.version_basis: builder SHA256; repository is not a git work tree

authoritative_stage1b_method_binding.numerical_method_reused: SGP4 TEME propagation -> Astropy GCRS -> SupGP/reference-defined RTN; ordinary minus reference

frame_time_assumptions.ordinary_initialization: TLE_LINE1/2 embedded in Space-Track OMM JSON via Satrec.twoline2rv
frame_time_assumptions.supgp_initialization: CelesTrak historical SupGP OMM via sgp4.omm.initialize
frame_time_assumptions.common_frame: GCRS via Astropy TEME transform at the common UTC evaluation epoch

deterministic_correctness_sample.selection_rule: per-satellite earliest/middle/latest union all >72h rows union first available row in each frozen support bin
